financials_motherson.html.notes: THE PRIMARY FIXTURE, and the only server-rendered source of all six financial tables. Page <title> is 'Samvardhana Motherson - Quarterly Results and Financial Statement as of Jun, 2026'. It carries 5 outermost tables, in this order, each of whose FIRST CELL of every data row is the machine row id (e.g. TotalShareHoldersFunds_A) and whose SECOND cell is the display label -- so a parser can key rows on the id, never on the label. table[0] 19 data rows x 15 cols = QUARTERLY P&L, header ['Indicator','Graph',"Jun '26","Mar '26","Dec '25","Sep '25","Jun '25","Mar '25","Dec '24","Sep '24","Jun '24","Mar '24","Dec '23","Sep '23","Jun '23"] -- 13 quarterly periods, newest first. table[1] 25 x 16 = ANNUAL P&L + TTM, header ['Indicator','Graph','CAGR 3 Yrs','CAGR 5 Yrs','TTM',"Mar '26","Mar '25","Mar '24","Mar '23","Mar '22","Mar '21","Mar '20","Mar '19","Mar '18","Mar '17","Mar '16"] -- 11 annual periods PLUS a literal 'TTM' column, and two CAGR columns. table[2] 34 x 15 = BALANCE SHEET, header ['Indicator','Graph','CAGR 3 Yrs','CAGR 5 Yrs',"Mar '26"..."Mar '16"] -- ANNUAL PERIODS ONLY, no quarterly column and no TTM column. table[3] 26 x 15 = FINANCIAL RATIOS, same 15-cell header, annual only. table[4] 9 x 15 = CASH FLOW, same 15-cell header, annual only. THE DECISIVE TRAP: tables[2], [3] and [4] have BYTE-IDENTICAL header rows, so a header signature matches all three at once and CANNOT discriminate balance sheet from ratios from cash flow -- the same defect tables.py records for buy-sell-zone. All 5 tables match NONE of the 8 registered signatures (class is null for every one), so no existing signature is close. The only discriminator available is the row-id column: CFO_A/CFI_A/CFA_A/NCF_A appear only in table[4], TA_A/TL_A/CA_A/CL_A only in table[2], ROE_A/ROCE_A only in table[3]. This page renders STANDALONE figures (TotalShareHoldersFunds_A at Mar '26 = 38,290.1, which equals the XHR's standalone dump, not its consolidated 40,979.6) and needs no request parameter to do so. Units are INR crore: body.tableInsightCurrency reads 'All financials are in INR Cr and price data in INR'. No restatement metadata is served on this route, so as-reported vs restated is UNVERIFIED and must not be asserted. Cells are pre-formatted strings ('3,827.7', '12.47%', '-'), so find_tables' keep_default_na=False / thousands=None contract is what keeps '-' from becoming NaN.

fundamental_results_motherson.json.notes: THE EVIDENCE FIXTURE, and the only source that can settle the quarterly question. One request serves all six financial tables. Standard trendlyne envelope, head.status == '0', so parse_envelope applies unchanged. body.order is a two-branch structure and the branch matters: order.quarter.<table> and order.annual.<table> each carry that table's period list for the Quarterly and Annual toggle respectively. order.quarter.qtr and order.annual.qtr are the same 13 quarters ['Jun 2026','Mar 2026','Dec 2025','Sep 2025','Jun 2025','Mar 2025','Dec 2024','Sep 2024','Jun 2024','Mar 2024','Dec 2023','Sep 2023','Jun 2023'], newest first. order.annual.annual additionally carries a 'TTM' period as its FIRST column, before 'Mar 2026'. ORDERING TRAP, measured: order.quarter.bs and order.quarter.cf DO list all 13 quarterly period labels, which reads as a quarterly balance sheet and a quarterly cash flow being offered -- but the rows those tables use (level_first_dict_map.bs = 13 indCodes, level_first_dict_map.cf = 4 indCodes) are ALL suffixed _A, and ZERO of the 260 _A keys appears anywhere in quarterlyDataDump, whose 82 distinct keys are 75 _Q + NP_TTM + EPS_TTM + 5 non-numeric extras. Reading the bs/cf row ids across order.quarter.bs gives 0 of 13 non-null, every single cell; the same rows across order.annual.bs give 13 of 13. So the quarterly column headers are advertised and the values are not there. The vendor's own server-rendered page agrees independently: in financials_motherson.html the balance sheet and cash flow tables carry only Mar '26..Mar '16 columns and no quarterly column at all. Period sources differ per table and must not be assumed: qtr -> quarterlyDataDump; annual, bs, cf and financialratios -> annualDataDump. Both dumps are keyed consolidated and standalone, so ONE request yields both bases, and the payload's is_consolidated flag (true here) is only the display default -- financials_motherson.html renders standalone. Row order per table is level_first_dict_map, a list of {indCode} in render order. Row labels and units are parameterMetadata[code].lstr / .name / .unit; observed units are 'Cr', '%', 'Rs', 'abs' and ''. Both TTM shapes exist: 'NP_TTM' and 'EPS_TTM' are ROWS of the quarterly P&L with a value in every one of the 13 quarters, AND 'TTM' is a COLUMN of the annual P&L -- the two agree, since NP_A at the 'TTM' column is 4,379.89 and NP_TTM at 'Jun 2026' is also 4,379.89. There is no TTM column or row for bs, cf or financialratios. body.stockData carries NSEcode, BSEcode, NSENumber, BSEScriptCode, stockName, ISIN, sectorName and industryName. body.isBanking is false, so a bank's extra CapitalAdequacyBaseII_Q / GrossNPA_Q / GNPARAT_Q rows are modelled but unpopulated here and this recording cannot speak to them.
